game.romname: Blazing Angels 2 - Secret Missions of WWII (USA)
game.name: Blazing Angels 2 : Secret Missions of WW II (Japan)
game.desc: Secret Missions of WWII for Xbox 360 is the second installment in the Blazing Angels series. The title features veteran pilots who have been working together in a secret squadron since the beginning of World War II. The team is tasked with the most perilous missions around the globe and must solve crises that are insurmountable for the average pilot.
